newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA still eyes Olympic for A$140 mln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA still eyes Olympic for A$140 mln.

text.p: Gaming machine group AWA Ltd has said it is interested in acquiring A$140 million poker machine maker Olympic, The Australian Financial Review said.
AWA chief executive John Rouse told the paper AWA was interested in buying Olympic, Australia's second largest poker machine maker behind Aristocrat Leisure Ltd.
Discussions with Olympic had broken down in December on price, "but that's not to say that those discussions might not be reopened at any time," Rouse was quoted as saying.
AWA's shares closed unchanged at 90 cents on Friday.
